cves.desc: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

cves.name: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.desc: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

cves.name: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
cves.desc: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

cves.name: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.desc: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

cves.name: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
cves.desc: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

cves.name: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cves.desc: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.
